records.department: Tamil Nadu — Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department
records.coverage: Tamil Nadu ration-card and public distribution services
records.description: Use the state's published food-services information to find the relevant ration-card or PDS service. Confirm the route for a new card, household change or eligibility enquiry.
steps: Find the specific ration-card or PDS service relevant to your request.
Confirm its current application channel and requirements with the Food Department before submitting.
conditions: A department or transparency portal is not itself proof that every ration-card change can be submitted online.
Eligibility and household-change requirements must be checked for the selected state and service.

contactPhone.purpose: Tamil Nadu PDS helpdesk published in the official NFSA state profile

records.department: Maharashtra — Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department
records.coverage: Maharashtra ration-card and public distribution services
records.description: NFSA links this Maharashtra citizen login for online ration-card applications. Choose the relevant available application service and review its current instructions.
steps: Open the RCMS citizen login linked by NFSA.
Choose the applicable available ration-card service, follow its instructions and retain the acknowledgement.
conditions: A new ration-card application route does not guarantee that every amendment or dispute can be completed through the same service.

contactPhone.purpose: Maharashtra PDS helpdesk published in the official NFSA state profile

contactEmail.purpose: Maharashtra Food Department PDS helpline contact published by NFSA
